purpose: Maintain a conclusion despite a condition, or affirm a statement strongly.
keywords: い-adjectiveく / Vなく + とも; sentence-final とも
Even if the journey is long, I will certainly go to see you.
Even without saying it aloud, you can convey your feelings in writing.
formation: い-adjectiveく / Vなく + とも; sentence-final とも
register: Written for concessions; affirmative ending can sound old-fashioned
restrictions: Concessive とも is close to ても; sentence-final とも instead gives assurance.
mistake: Read the attachment carefully: the conditional and affirmative uses are different.
